vulnerabilities.observation: Arena.perspective includes anonymous unclassified public:false event in both team projections
vulnerabilities.required: VisibleEventDTO typed allowlist default-deny; never copy arbitrary event details; apply same filter session/SSE/reconnect

vulnerabilities.observation: Room.subscribe immediately sends filtered snapshot on reconnect, no per-seat SSE id or journal; Last-Event-ID ignored
vulnerabilities.required: RoomEpoch+Seat+Revision cursor, explicit snapshot resync on gap; optionally journal with per-seat authorization

vulnerabilities.observation: Room.broadcast sends duplicate revision even without state change; browser accepts revision >= lastRevision
vulnerabilities.required: client ignores duplicate/older revision and binds frame to session epoch and authenticated seat

vulnerabilities.observation: Persist failure leaves live room ahead of durable checkpoint (A13), creating SSE state/ACK divergence
vulnerabilities.required: persist snapshot+receipt+revision atomically before publish, then per-seat SSE snapshot

vulnerabilities.observation: Legacy server SSE ignores backpressure, lacks Last-Event-ID handling and in-memory replay queue
vulnerabilities.required: bounded queues and drain/cancel; on reconnect full authorized snapshot from committed store, no raw checkpoint

vulnerabilities.observation: client lastRevision global can survive room change (A08)
vulnerabilities.required: reset revision and cursor on room/seat epoch changes and ignore late old-stream callbacks

contract.identity: seat derived exclusively from authenticated session; never pass client-chosen team/seat as authority
contract.cursor: room_epoch/seat_id/committed_revision, unique within one room epoch, per-seat bound; never accept cursor as authentication
contract.initial: publish one full per-seat sanitized committed snapshot; no raw RNG, tokenHash or enemy orders
contract.gap: if last committed revision missing, malformed, future, wrong room or wrong seat, send current authorized snapshot and mark resync; no replay of raw event journal
contract.same: on reconnect with matching revision, sending identical sanitized snapshot is acceptable; browser dedupes by cursor/revision
contract.order: storage commit then immutable in-memory publish, then per-seat SSE frame, then ACK; in case lost ACK retry returns original durable receipt
contract.events: deny missing scope/unknown kind and project only explicitly allowed event fields; any arbitrary details/property spreads prohibited
contract.client: validate cursor, room epoch and seat, use > monotonic revision, discard exact duplicate and all old-room callbacks
contract.expected_dynamic: one human controls five units for blue/red; opponent concealed positions/items/orders cannot appear in reconnect
contract.caveats: Node reference trusts injected auth seat, is single-room toy storage and does not implement production cookies, TLS, WAL or game mechanics; QA only
